caveats: Bounded sample, not all installations or historical formats. Insiders metadata was discovered but its sessions were not sampled.
All 32 surveyed source hashes stayed unchanged during the run. Stable bytes do not prove complete producer recording.
101 names occur in actual-call inventories. 259 names occur across calls, configured schemas, copies and reference records. Do not equate these populations.
Three exported SDK samples have verified Agent Host mappings. Other surveyed SDK origins were not established.

S001: four of five recorded answer strings match saved Markdown after whitespace normalization despite passing general verification. This is not a semantic/ownership audit, and escaping may affect matching.
S017: export and saved-file verification both fail Layer D with exit 2. Root cause was not diagnosed by this LOD research.
Full field-path inventories, source identities/hashes, exact commands, logs, capture paths and chat contents are intentionally not copied here.
The original ignored corpus includes additional raw field-path inventories. Their absence does not prevent use of the distinct type/tool/variant catalogues preserved here.
